precondition_sources.text: A fee-on-transfer token is whitelisted as a reward token.
The token deducts a percentage fee on every transfer, so a transfer of 100 delivers less than 100 to the recipient.

intent_sources.text: The balance credited to a user (and the amount recorded for a campaign pull) must equal the amount of tokens actually received by the contract, not the amount requested.
